title: Missouri couple win $47,500 after former sellers block property sale over a paid-off mortgage
summary_full: In a challenging situation, a couple in Missouri struggled to sell their home when previous sellers refused to acknowledge a cleared mortgage. This conflict prompted a court's decision to award them $47,500 in damages after evidence confirmed the mortgage was paid off. The ruling also covered legal fees, underscoring the critical need for transparent financial protocols in real estate dealings.
